column1: # Reglas de triaje OWASP ZAP Baseline (TS-08 / OPS-17 / CA-18)

column3: X-Frame-Options Header Not Set (exigido DENY en Nginx — CA-8)
X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing (exigido nosniff en Nginx — CA-8)
Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set (exigido HSTS en Nginx/TLS — CA-8)
Server Leaks Version Information via Server HTTP Response Header (server_tokens off — CA-8)
Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set (exigido CSP sin unsafe-inline — CA-8)
Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens (Falso positivo: API REST stateless autenticada por cabecera Authorization Bearer JWT, sin cookies de sesion — ADR-004)
Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments (bundles minificados de Vite/React)
Timestamp Disclosure - Unix (campos timestamp estandar en respuestas RFC 7807 — ADR-012)
Storable and Cacheable Content (assets estaticos versionados por hash de Vite)
